paragraphs: Rabbi Ammi bar Chama. See Rami bar Chama, and Rami: Heilprin compares Ammi with Rami in the Yerushalmi. In his cited example with the patronym Yechezkel, the Yerushalmi reads Immi and the Bavli reads Rami.
